code: Add a deterministic synchronized-pair builder that consumes the hash-bound 41-representative M5 capture, aligns timestamps using an explicit intersection policy, rejects duplicate or missing-bar contamination, and emits pair-level provenance.

Add product-comparability validation covering quote currency, contract/unit semantics, price scale, trading-session overlap, minimum aligned observations, and broker-symbol identity; failures must be explicit and auditable.

Add a predeclared diagnostic pipeline that estimates hedge parameters only on the development split, computes spread and stationarity diagnostics, and evaluates the frozen holdout split without refitting.
Add stability checks across predefined rolling subwindows and parameter perturbations; no pair ranking, winner selection, economic signal, order logic, or cost claim is permitted.

failure_criteria: Insufficient aligned observations or excessive missingness.
Non-finite prices, returns, hedge estimates, or test statistics.
Failure of the predeclared stationarity threshold in development or holdout.
Material hedge or stationarity instability under the predeclared subwindow and perturbation checks.
Any leakage, refitting on holdout data, duplicate identity, or untraceable input hash.
diagnostic_specification.hedge: Estimate an intercept and hedge coefficient on the development partition only using the predeclared regression method; retain signed and absolute hedge diagnostics.
diagnostic_specification.stability: Repeat the fixed diagnostic over predeclared chronological subwindows and coefficient perturbations; report dispersion and sign consistency.
diagnostic_specification.stationarity: Run the predeclared residual stationarity test on development and untouched holdout partitions with fixed test settings and record statistic, p-value, and sample size.
diagnostic_specification.synchronization: Use only common UTC M5 timestamps from the accepted capture; preserve missingness indicators and reject pairs below the predeclared aligned-observation threshold.
diagnostic_specification.time_split: Chronological development, validation, and holdout partitions are fixed before execution; no holdout-derived tuning or pair exclusion is allowed.

evidence_outputs: A hash-bound structural diagnostic plan and configuration artifact.
A pair-alignment and product-comparability audit for all admissible pairs.
A diagnostic result artifact containing development, validation, holdout, stability, and failure fields without economic interpretation.
A machine-readable execution manifest recording input hashes, code version, test results, and rejection reasons.
scope_constraints: Enumerate the complete accepted 41-representative input scope; do not select a winning pair or retroactively narrow the frontier.
Do not use consumed C032 evidence or any outcome-exposed artifact as prospective input.
Do not authorize economic execution, independent confirmation, transaction-cost analysis, or live trading.
tests: Unit tests for UTC alignment, missing-bar handling, duplicate rejection, product-comparability guards, deterministic hashing, and chronological split boundaries.
Statistical fixture tests with synthetic cointegrated and non-cointegrated series verifying expected stationarity and failure classifications.
Leakage tests proving holdout data cannot alter hedge fitting, thresholds, pair inclusion, or diagnostic configuration.
Integration test over the accepted epoch23 capture verifying schema, provenance, deterministic output, and one record per admissible unordered pair.
Regression test proving no economic outcome, order, cost, margin, or protected-forward artifact is emitted.

later_gates: Independent review of structural diagnostic validity and data sufficiency.
Authenticated Pepperstone symbol, cost, margin, and execution verification if a later economic envelope is proposed.
Prospective freeze and exact-head confidence-interval review before any economic outcome authorization.
